# Thyroid

Graves disease is caused by antibodies that stimulate the TSH receptor.
Hashimoto thyroiditis is the commonest cause of hypothyroidism where iodine intake is adequate.
Carbimazole may cause agranulocytosis, so a sore throat needs an urgent blood count.
Papillary carcinoma is the commonest thyroid cancer and shows Orphan Annie eye nuclei.
Medullary carcinoma secretes calcitonin and is linked with MEN 2 syndromes.
